مُعَنَّزٌ Small in the head (Ibn-'Abbád, O, K) and ears. (Ibn-'Abbád, O.) ―
-b2- مُعَنَّزُ الوَجْهِ A man (A, O) having little flesh in his face. (A, O, K.) ―
-b3- مُعَنَّزُ اللِّحْيَةِ Whose beard is like [that of] the goat: (K:) applied to a man as though his beard were like the beard of the goat: (O:) meaning, as expl. by Aboo-Dáwood, بُزْ بُزْ رِيشْ in Pers. meaning the “ goat ” [and رِيشْ the “ beard ”]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
